name: Invertebrates - routing (hermit crabs, tarantulas, insects): LHCOS / HCA / Sean Casey / Small n Furry
neighborhoods: NYC (via national programs that connect local rehomers & adopters) + a regional NJ exotic rescue
notes: No standalone NYC invertebrate-only rescue exists. Best paths: for LAND HERMIT CRABS, the Land Hermit Crab Owners Society (LHCOS) runs a structured national adoption program with a location-based map that connects NYC rehomers with approved local adopters (free adoptions, science-based care standards); the Hermit Crab Association (HCA) is a second community. For TARANTULAS and other exotic invertebrates, Sean Casey Animal Rescue (Brooklyn) has taken them and is the best in-city call; Small n Furry Rescue (central NJ) is a regional exotic rescue experienced with hermit crabs and invertebrates. Never release pet inverts outdoors. Intake: LHCOS adoption/rehoming application  (free adoptions; location-based adopter map) or Hermit Crab Association Intake: Sean Casey Animal Rescue Intake: Regional NJ exotic/hermit-crab rescue: Small n Furry Rescue Other channel: LHCOS on Facebook Other channel: Small n Furry Rescue on Facebook
